_law: A commit may delete files on purpose, but only by declaring them here by name. Tools/tree_shrink_guard.py clears a shrink ONLY when this file's declared path set equals the commit's actual deletion set exactly -- a partial, superset or wrong-path declaration stays red (selftest L13-L17). Never raise --max-drop to silence a real shrink.

declarations.reason: scratch inspection output from the previous window (catalog dump, queue-open dump, smoke stderr tail); none of it is an artifact any consumer reads, and results/ underscore-prefixed dumps are working files, not faces

not a JSON face at all: a leftover prose header an earlier window wrote, which json_face_guard and the pre-commit claw both judged unreadable; that window pushed its already-staged deletion. No reader consumes it, and restoring it would re-poison the commit face, so the deletion is declared here by name instead
